castle.title: The Castle of Caccamo
castle.leading_para: The Castle of Caccamo is one of the largest and best-preserved Norman fortresses in Sicily. Standing on a sheer rock since the 11th century, it dominates the San Leonardo valley as a millenary strategic bulwark.
castle.para_2: Every corner of this manor exudes charm and mystery: from the famous Conspiracy Hall, the scene of intrigues and pacts between medieval nobles, to the ancient prisons carved into the stone used by the Inquisition.
castle.para_3: Between history and legend, the spirit of Sister Felicia still protects the village today. The Castellana awaits you in chat to reveal every secret of this timeless place.
castle.welcomemsg_felicia: Welcome to the Castle of Caccamo, stranger. I am Sister Felicia. Would you like me to reveal the secrets of the Conspiracy Hall, or would you rather listen to the ancient legends of the castle? Feel free to ask.

castello.title: Caccamo Castle
castello.description: Caccamo Castle is among the largest and best-preserved Norman fortresses in Sicily. Perched on bare rock since the 11th century, it dominates the San Leonardo valley with its imposing walls, watchtowers, and suggestive internal halls that evoke centuries of feudal history and chivalric legends.

badia.title: Church of San Benedetto alla Badia
badia.description: A true jewel of Sicilian Baroque, this church is world-famous for its extraordinary floor entirely made of 18th-century majolica, depicting allegorical scenes and naturalistic motifs of rare mastery. A masterpiece of visual art suspended in time.
badia.hours: Tue - Sun: 09:00 – 12:30 | Mon: 14:30 – 18:30 (No regular mass, ideal for visits)
badia.tickets: Full € 2.00 | Reduced € 1.00 (EU Youth 18-25 or with Castle ticket on the same day) | Free under 18

santamaria.title: Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli
santamaria.description: Founded in the XV century together with the Dominican convent, the Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli is one of the most important spiritual centers of the village. It houses the remains and relics of Blessed Giovanni Liccio, Patron Saint of Caccamo. Inside, you can admire splendid marble altars and sacred art pieces.
santamaria.hours: Opening & Visits: Saturday from 16:00 to 17:30 | Sunday from 09:00 to 10:00 and from 11:00 to 12:30. (Holy Mass: Saturday at 17:30 | Sunday at 10:00).

sangiorgio.title: Church of San Giorgio Martire
sangiorgio.description: The Mother Church of Caccamo, dedicated to Saint George the Martyr, is an imposing masterpiece dominating the monumental square below the Castle. Founded in the Norman era and rebuilt in 1614, it preserves an immense artistic heritage: from Gaginian school sculptures to precious 17th-century paintings by Flemish artist Matthias Stom.
sangiorgio.hours: Visiting Hours: Saturday and Sunday 09:30 – 10:45 and 16:00 – 18:00. (Tourist admission is suspended during Sunday Holy Mass at 11:00).

annunziata.title: SS. Annunziata Parish
annunziata.description: Set within the medieval urban fabric, the church stands out for its facade and the atmosphere of deep spirituality inside. It preserves finely decorated altars and artistic artifacts that attract visitors and devotees.
annunziata.hours: Mon - Sat: 09:00 – 12:00 | Weekday Mass at 18:00. Sunday and Holidays visiting hours: 08:30 - 09:30 and 10:30 - 12:00 (Festive Masses at 09:30, 12:00, 19:00).

cappuccini.title: Convent of the Capuchin Friars
cappuccini.description: A place of silence, meditation, and history, the Convent structures are deeply linked to the Franciscan tradition in Sicily. Beyond the conventual building, the area offers an authentic glimpse into monastic life and popular devotion.
cappuccini.hours: Accessible mainly upon request or during Franciscan celebrations. Contact the Tourism Office.
cappuccini.secret_info: 💡 The Hidden Jewels of Caccamo: The village hosts 33 churches. Use the Din Don Dan map and zoom in on Caccamo to discover real-time hours and openings of lesser-known treasures like the Church of San Rocco.
